# ChartKit JSON spec

> v0.5.0. Schema: https://chartkit.dev/schema/v1.json. `render` from `@chartkitdev/core/all`. `repair` and `validate` from `@chartkitdev/core/validate`.

## Rules

- `version` is `"1"`. `a11y.alt` is one sentence and is required.
- `data` is an array of row objects, not `{ "values": [...] }`. Sparkline, mini-area, and spike may use a number array. Large data may use `{ "columns": { "field": [] } }`.
- `type` is the chart. `mark` is options (`curve`, `sampling`, `layout`), not a string.
- Gauge, kpi, and progress-ring put the number in `metric` (`value`, `min`, `max`, `delta`, `label`). A `data` object of those fields moves into `metric`.
- Donut uses `encoding.x` (slice label) and `encoding.y` (slice value). Not `theta`, `angle`, or `label`.
- `encoding.*.axis` is `"y"` or `"y2"`. Titles go in `axes.y.title` or `axes.y2.title`.
- Field types are `quantitative`, `temporal`, `ordinal`, or `nominal`. Not `categorical`.
- Heatmap: `x` + `y` + `color` is a grid. Calendar is a date `x` plus `color`, or `mark.layout: "calendar"`. The measure is `encoding.color`, not `encoding.value`. `grid-heatmap` and `calendar-heatmap` are `heatmap` plus `mark.layout`.
- Combo: `encoding.y` is `[{ "field", "mark": "bar" }, { "field", "mark": "line", "axis": "y2" }]`. Not `layer`, `layers`, `marks`, or `encoding.bar` / `encoding.line`. A field list goes on `encoding.y`, not on `field`. `bar`, `line`, and `area` go in `mark`, not in `type`. A series with `"axis": "y2"` needs `axes.y2`; `repair` adds it if missing.
- A bar splits series with `encoding.series`, or with `encoding.color` when that field is not `x`. `encoding.color` equal to `x` colours each bar and does not split series. `mark.stack` is `"stack"` or `"percent"`. `scale.type` `"log"` is a log axis. A temporal `x` is a time axis. `format` on an axis or channel formats the ticks. Rule, band, and text annotations are drawn. Tooltip, zoom, pan, brush, animation, `legend.interactive`, `a11y.keyboard`, and `a11y.dataTable` warn CK3011 when on (not drawn yet). Omitted theme is `auto` (transparent, `prefers-color-scheme`, `--ck-*` or `--chart-N`). `theme: "midnight"` is the dark card.

## Repair loop

1. `validate(spec)`.
2. If not ok, `repair(spec)` applies each `fix` and returns `{ spec, ok, errors, applied }` without mutating the input.
3. Render the repaired spec when `ok`. A missing `type` is reported first, with a patch.

`repair` does not invent data.

## line

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "line",
  "data": [
    { "quarter": "Q1", "units": 40 },
    { "quarter": "Q2", "units": 55 },
    { "quarter": "Q3", "units": 48 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "quarter", "y": "units" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Units peaked in Q2." }
}
```

## bar

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "bar",
  "data": [
    { "lane": "A", "stops": 12 },
    { "lane": "B", "stops": 7 },
    { "lane": "C", "stops": 15 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "lane", "y": "stops" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Lane C has the most stops." }
}
```

## donut

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "donut",
  "data": [
    { "wood": "Oak", "boards": 8 },
    { "wood": "Pine", "boards": 5 },
    { "wood": "Maple", "boards": 3 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "wood", "y": "boards" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Oak is the largest share of boards." }
}
```

## stacked-area

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "stacked-area",
  "data": [
    { "year": "2022", "rail": 20, "road": 30 },
    { "year": "2023", "rail": 24, "road": 28 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "year", "y": ["rail", "road"] },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Road stayed larger than rail." }
}
```

## scatter

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "scatter",
  "data": [
    { "temp": 16, "yieldKg": 3 },
    { "temp": 22, "yieldKg": 5 },
    { "temp": 27, "yieldKg": 4 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "temp", "y": "yieldKg" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Yield is highest at 22 degrees." }
}
```

## combo

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "combo",
  "data": [
    { "week": "W1", "orders": 30, "rate": 0.4 },
    { "week": "W2", "orders": 36, "rate": 0.55 }
  ],
  "encoding": {
    "x": "week",
    "y": [
      { "field": "orders", "mark": "bar" },
      { "field": "rate", "mark": "line", "axis": "y2" }
    ]
  },
  "axes": { "y2": { "title": "Fill rate" } },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Orders and the fill rate both rose." }
}
```

## heatmap

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "heatmap",
  "data": [
    { "bin": "A", "band": "Low", "level": 1 },
    { "bin": "B", "band": "Low", "level": 4 },
    { "bin": "A", "band": "High", "level": 2 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "bin", "y": "band", "color": "level" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Bin B in the low band is the darkest cell." }
}
```

## gauge

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "gauge",
  "metric": { "label": "Capacity", "value": 64, "min": 0, "max": 100 },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Capacity is 64 out of 100." }
}
```

## kpi

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "kpi",
  "metric": { "label": "Tickets", "value": 18, "delta": -0.05 },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Open tickets are 18, slightly down." }
}
```

## sparkline

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "sparkline",
  "data": [4, 6, 5, 9, 8],
  "a11y": { "alt": "The sparkline ends higher than it starts." }
}
```

## mini-area

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "mini-area",
  "data": [2, 3, 3, 6, 5],
  "a11y": { "alt": "The mini area rises, then eases." }
}
```

## progress-ring

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "progress-ring",
  "metric": { "label": "Done", "value": 3, "min": 0, "max": 8 },
  "a11y": { "alt": "3 of 8 items are done." }
}
```

## spike

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "spike",
  "data": [
    { "slot": "t1", "hits": 0 },
    { "slot": "t2", "hits": 6 },
    { "slot": "t3", "hits": 1 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "slot", "y": "hits" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "Hits spike at t2." }
}
```

## candlestick

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "type": "candlestick",
  "data": [
    { "day": "D1", "open": 5, "high": 7, "low": 4, "close": 6 },
    { "day": "D2", "open": 6, "high": 6, "low": 3, "close": 4 }
  ],
  "encoding": { "x": "day", "open": "open", "high": "high", "low": "low", "close": "close" },
  "a11y": { "alt": "The second session closed below its open." }
}
```

## React

`<Chart spec={...} />` from `@chartkitdev/react` renders this spec. Named components (`LineChart`, `GaugeChart`, and the rest) take their own props. Those props are not spec keys.
